CustomField.description: How a Hero Banner is laid out. Full picture: the picture fills the banner with the text on top. Split: text on a dark purple band on the left and the picture beside it (below it on narrow screens). Blank or unknown means Full picture.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Full picture puts the text over the picture. Split puts the text on a purple band with the picture beside it; Text position and Overlay are not used.
CustomField.label: Hero Layout
